sources.title: Get Listed page (returned 403 to fetch; referenced by help docs)
GoodFirms help: How can my business get listed on GoodFirms
Blastra directory profile of GoodFirms: free listings + paid upgrades, accepts SaaS/software product listings

requirements: B2B-oriented: company profile with services/software details; accepts software products (SaaS, AI tools, hardware) and service/agency listings
Service categories chosen at submission cannot be edited later — pick carefully
Submission goes through manual approval before the listing appears
preparation: Company name, website, contact details, and company description
Service categories that best match the product (irreversible choice)
Logo and portfolio/case-study material for a fuller profile
Client references that can later leave reviews (ranking factors in review quality/quantity)
workflow: Fill in the company details form
Choose the appropriate Service Categories — this cannot be changed later
Submit the form and await approval
After approval, encourage clients/users to leave reviews to improve ranking
watchFor: Category selection is permanent — the help centre explicitly warns it cannot be edited later
Paid upgrades (featured placement, enhanced profiles, research-report inclusion) are upsold but not required for a listing
countsAsLive: The company profile page on goodfirms.co is publicly reachable and the company appears in its chosen category listing
